task: Provisional condition/purpose/symptom relevance, not prescribing eligibility or dose selection
decision_order: Unknown or unsupported condition -> undetermined; do not infer a diagnosis
No catalogue use mapping for this condition -> not_relevant (contrast row only)
Mapped antiviral -> relevant to its treatment purpose, without declaring an individual indication
Mapped symptom relief: any declared target present -> relevant
Mapped symptom relief: all declared targets explicitly absent -> not_relevant
Otherwise -> undetermined; unknown is not absent
interpretation: These are researcher-defined source-informed criteria executed as rules; no human labels are fabricated.
Catalogue mapping evidence does not directly provide these patient-level labels.
A relevant row may be blocked or unassessable by deterministic controls.
No within-purpose ranking is measured: each supported condition/clinical-role group has one product.
Antiviral mapped rows have constant relevance labels; report insufficient within-product variation.
